# Pick Your Row

Pick Your Row (pickyourrow.com) is an original editorial site from Joshua Israel Ventures LLC. It publishes schematic airline seat maps and practical guides for choosing a seat.

Seat maps on this site are original illustrations built from publicly known typical cabin facts. They are not scraped from airlines, SeatGuru, AeroLOPA, or other seat map sites. Configurations are illustrative. Interiors vary by aircraft registration and retrofit. Always confirm seats with the carrier before you fly.

Pick Your Row is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any airline.

## Method

Editorial seat scores are opinions for planning, not guarantees and not airline advice. The methodology page explains the approach and lists public citations for passenger rights, exit seating rules, and safety context.
